say:3:1910226003:1.text: What in the world is that?

say:5:1910226005:1.text: Starfa sometimes uses it to reinforce Coralia's defenses.

say:6:1910226006:1.text: But why is it here? Did someone put it here on purpose? Maybe it's like those stories where someone finds a treasure and triggers a trap meant to keep thieves away...

say:9:1910226008:1.text: Remember the melody played on the tideharp? There's a specific melody for dealing with ironlock seaweed too!

say:10:1910226009:1.text: When you play it, the power in the currents lulls the seaweed to sleep. Then we can untangle it!

say:14:1910226012:1.text: Let me explain! We use ironlock seaweed to protect our treasures and keep the big fish out. After all, they can't read sheet music the way we can!
say:14:1910226012:1.source_cn: 我们会用铁缄藻来保护重要物品，或是防止大型鱼类乱冲乱撞...

say:15:1910226013:1.text: There are so many songs with special powers that we need a way to keep track of them. What if someone forgets the one that removes the seaweed? Their treasures would be locked away forever!

say:16:1910226014:1.text: ... I really don't get you people.

say:17:1910226015:0.text: See that <style="highlight">conch shell</style>? It's a <style="highlight">sea-singing conch</style>, and we use it to practice playing these songs.

say:18:1910226016:1.text: All sorts of wild things can happen if we mess up, you know. That's why we practice on sea-singing conches until we get the songs right.
